integrity: The complete proof, scope, inspected literature and reproducible finite check are embedded. The same-model review is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite graphs, redundancy q>=2, both shores at least q+2; nonequivariant integral homotopy. The known ordinary q=1 visibility characterization is not novel. Finite GF(2) enumeration corroborates but does not establish the infinite integral proof. Unindexed equivalent statements remain possible.
title: Integral sphere wedges for fault-tolerant mutual-visibility complexes of complete bipartite graphs
